name: EX Icons Styleguide
description: Bridges ex_icons module with Styleguide module and provides a preview of all available icons.
project_description:
This module provides an integration of External-use icons (ex_icons) and the Styleguide modules.

It gathers the external-use icons available on the site and generates an entry on the available theme styleguides, rendering every icon in a responsive grid together with its ID.

It is useful for developers (a single page exposing all available icons to troubleshoot, test and improve icon libraries), for automated tests such as visual regression (icons are output using exactly the same render arrays as the original module, so regressions and changes are detectable), for end-users, content editors, product owners and site builders (a living styleguide that acts as self-documentation for training, deliverables and client QA), and for designers (design reviews and better communication with front-end developers).

The module needs no configuration or activation beyond enabling it. Each theme styleguide is reachable at /admin/appearance/styleguide/THEME_NAME, provided by the Styleguide module.
